original_image_inputs.role: Mandatory muted olive palette and low-frequency visual reference; original file remains reference-only.

generation_inputs.role: Discarded first grass redraw, used only as fine grass-blade rendering reference in the selected correction.

prompt: Edit request: produce a corrected high-resolution grass material,6:5 opaque rectangular canvas, continuous painted grass at least1024 pixels wide. Image1 original96x80 low-res tile is the PRIMARY exact color-and-composition target. Image2 is an earlier high-res redraw that is too saturated, too yellow and much too contrasty; use ONLY its quality of fine grass-blade rendering, NOT its colors or placement. CRITICAL: match Image1's muted olive moss-green average hue/value and soft low-contrast light/dark rounded patch arrangement faithfully. At96x80 Lanczos reduction it should resemble Image1 extremely closely. Recover the identical broad grass clump positions from Image1, treat it as the exact low-frequency composition map and add fine hand-painted blade/tuft details within those same forms; do not invent a new arrangement or generic noise. Image1's light green cushions and darker olive pockets are soft relief, not lime yellow tussock mounds; match their scale and their modest contrast. No pixel grid or nearest-neighbor blocks in finished highres; smoothly reconstruct organic boundaries, with detailed small blades under matching diffuse upper-left light. Output the complete rectangular grass image including organically filled corner overscan beyond original hex; no visible hex mask, outline, dark corners or transparency. No other objects, no flowers, stones, earth, shrubs, paths, labels, borders, text or UI. Preserve exact original muted greens while giving high-res material life and natural fine grass detail. The goal is original fidelity at small size with new high-resolution surface detail.
cleanup: Generated source preserved unchanged. No post-generation sharpening, procedural detail, original-pixel blending or color correction.

review.goal: User requests high-resolution grass that visually resembles the original above 90% when Lanczos-reduced to original size. This is a visual target, not an achieved numeric metric.
review.caveat: Existing sampleConnectionMaterial mirror-wraps the material and averages two lattice cosets; judge actual exported grass, not only a direct source reduction. Original-size similarity and connected-scene acceptance remain for review.
